DISTRIBUTION (map 16): Known from southeastern South Australia and the Kalgoorlie region of Western Australia.

Distribution. This species, new to Saudi Arabia, is found in the central region (Hail, Qassim, and Riyadh provinces), the western region (Madinah Province), and the northern region (Jouf Province) (Fig. 7). Its elevation ranges from 518 to 1136 m a. s. l. Globally, it is distributed across the Mediterranean Basin, including Egypt, Libya, Israel, Palestine, Syria, and Turkey.
